text: AVA Entry Points and User Control
Page buttons open AVA chat. The user reviews proposals before applying changes.
Open AVA
Ask AVA in the project header, or Draft with AVA in the PSR editor.
Review proposal
An authorized PM reviews the narrative or proposed assignment / progress change.
Apply or dismiss
The user takes a separate action. Submission and approval remain separate.
Actions follow role and project access. Applying changes requires enabled suggestions.
